Transcription with verbose JSON response format including timestamp segments

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"file\":\"audio.mp3\",\"model\":\"whisper-1\",\"response_format\":\"verbose_json\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, CreateTranscriptionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.transcribe(req);
        System.out.println(result.text());
        System.out.println(result.segments());
        System.out.println(result.segments().get(0).id());
        }
    }
}
```
